title: Factors Associated With Future Fractures in Middle-aged Men and Women
brief_summary: From prospectively collected health and life-style data and anthropometric data in the Malmo Diet and Cancer (MDC) cohort identify factors that predicts or are associated with forthcoming fracture in middle-aged men and women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Invited population based cohort from 1990's

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
